a2da4db501309b076919.text: Look at the infographic and print text below.

063879c510838b4e2833.text: The concept of diversity is more than just acknowledging our differences. It is about understanding and recogizing that everyone is unique and different. By valuing diversity, we can live free from prejudices and create a success-oriented community.

c51554dff6ef89b598aa.text: Diversity is more than just a color

0a1935fa82a8dcda4f32.text: ● What is the topic of the infographic and the print text? ● How were the information presented in the infographic and the print text?

0ea8244eac3e5b2c91ad.text: The topic diversity was presented using the infographic and the print text. The infographic talks about how we should understand and communicate our differences while in the print text, diversity was defined as understanding and recognizing our differences to create a prejudice- free and success-oriented community.

207461c83999ffd95854.text: In the infographic, diversity was discussed in short phrases while in print text, diversity was discussed in sentences.

d45ab55bfe7e8890a7ae.text: Infographics and print text are examples of multimodal text.

2134ed41fcc77b78c4c0.text: Multimodal Texts are often live, digital text, or paper-based. It requires the processing of more than one method and the recognition of the interconnections between information.

3022ea7054bbc6e68e44.text: ● Live multimodal texts are shown through combinations of different modes such as gestural, spatial, audio, and oral language. The following are examples of live multimodal texts:

3bae77188ea0e8389070.text: o Dance – the expression of an idea or emotion through the use of body movements in a rhythmic way, accompanied with music

82f7f2e19885da1ae797.text: o Oral presentation - the delivery of an idea in front of a public audience

c6433480e27b2e4a1888.text: ● Digital multimodal texts is presented through dynamic combinations of various modes across written and spoken language, still and moving visual image, audio, gesture, and spatial communicative resources. The following are examples of digital multimodal texts:

aa93593aae3325eb4c78.text: o Films - is a form of storytelling using a series of moving images shown on the screen, usually with sounds

3e39a02b0cba72bf04d2.text: o Animation - is a method of storytelling using figures that are manipulated to appear as a series of moving images

28981156df9465a7f003.text: o Slideshows - is a presentation that is based on a series of projected images or photographic slides

37c84e9d472cec699459.text: o e-posters - or electronic posters is a digital presentation of a study and can be accessed through the use of softwares

35c26582fa0e9d3ef089.text: o Digital stories - is a multimedia presentation of a narrative structure combining a variety of digital elements

bf463e428395c034d177.text: ● Paper- based multimodal texts are conveyed to the reader through varying combinations of written language and still images. The following are examples of paper-based multimodal texts:

a2dcbfa38eaa0dfd79de.text: o Infographics - is a collection of images, charts, and data to present a quick and clear information

6960065ca79355613f84.text: o Graphic texts - presents information and data with the use of words in diagrams and drawings

f6ec336eb7a30285ef98.text: o Posters - is a large printed picture or a notice that is used for advertising or decoration

7433539189543ac9554e.text: o Comics - is a a medium of narration using images combined with text

3ca01dbbc2bbe9dd6030.text: o Picture - is an image or drawing that represent a certain topic

fd56e39588a3961aee80.text: Learning multimodal text is an efficient way for you to become familiar with the different methods of learning, remembering, and studying information. This will enhance your ability to retain information at a deeper level and recalling it at a later date will become quicker and more successful.
